title: Action of the normalized Hermite basis
statement: For each nonnegative integer $k$, let $H_k$ be the polynomial obtained by multiplying the $k$th Hermite polynomial, with its integer coefficients viewed as real coefficients, by $(k!)^{-1/2}$. The $k$th element of the basis of $\mathbb R[X]$ formed from these normalized Hermite polynomials is exactly $H_k$.
